name: Vrancea
summary: Vrancea is a county in the historical regions of Moldova and Muntenia in Romania. The county has an area of 4,863 km², and its residence is the municipality of Focșani. The main rivers are: Siret, Șușița, Putna, Milcov, Râmnicu Sărat. The highest altitudes are held by the Lăcăuț and Goru peaks. Vrancea County borders Vaslui County to the north-east, Galați County to the east, Brăila County to the south-east, Buzău County to the south, Covasna County to the west, and Bacău County to the north. The county is situated between the geographical coordinates 45°23’ and 46°11’ north latitude and 26°23’ and 27°32’ east longitude, being located in the south-east of the country, at the curvature of the Eastern Carpathians.
